mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved corporate earnings prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with sustained INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $700 billion, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS > $700 billion, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance combined with tame inflation supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in UNRATE (> 0.5% in 1 month), signaling labor market softening, leads to reduced investor expectations for future earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances with sudden UNRATE increases, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1.5 million units, indicating a strong housing market, broader economic growth is supported, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods with strong HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).
